§5.1 **TS-03** (no claim the record does not support), **TS-10** (unknowns
named honestly), **TS-12** and G2 §6's claim rules ·
**Base:** `r11/P34.11-honest-home-dossier-coverage-copy-v2` (chain tip —
merge after it) ·
**Ticket:**
`docs/tickets/214_P34.12__research-queue-truth-fixes.md`
(manifest row 214 — Round 11 / P34, sub-round 11A) ·
**Findings closed/partial:** RQ-00 (K11); QW-10 + F-113/F-274 (fixture
`/task/new/` intake + "has been generated" copy retired); C3 NEW-13

## Why

The research queue showed broken and invented things: task cards had no
stable identity and their `id` was a jurisdiction slug — five tasks in one
jurisdiction produced five identical, dead anchors; the jurisdiction filter
linked to fragments that did not exist. Export shaping emitted placeholder
metadata — `assignee_class: "contributor"` (a class that does not exist in
the catalog), `effort_estimate: "unknown"`, and `dispositions` that were
either the single current disposition or `[]`, none of which is the §33.4
vocabulary the page claims to speak. Absence hatches linked to
fixture-generated `/task/new/<slug>/` intake pages that declared "a research
task has been generated from this gap" — an invented workflow. And the
page-scoped "How we know this" line said "this page's own evidence" without
naming which page.

## What this does

1. **Every task has a stable identity and a live anchor (RQ-00).**
   `task_id` is added to the card shape end to end: the raw export query
   already selected it, `_research_queue` now emits it (optional in the
   frozen `public_surface_contracts.schema.json` — additive, so older
   exports still validate), the fixtures carry stable `fx-*` ids, and the
   card `id` is `taskAnchor(card)` — `task-<slugged task_id>`, falling back
   to a `(task_type, subject_id)` key for rows without one.
   `assertUniqueTaskAnchors` runs at build time: a collision fails the
   build, never silently dedupes. The jurisdiction filter strip derives its
   hrefs from `jurisdictionAnchors(cards)` — the anchor of each
   jurisdiction's first *rendered* card — so every filter link is a live
   fragment by construction.
2. **Catalog-backed queue metadata (K11 §5.5 / §33.2).**
   `_research_queue` joins `tasks.catalog.catalog()` on `task_type`:
   catalog rows emit the real `assignee_class`, `effort_estimate`,
   `geographic_scope` (the SCOPE vocabulary, not the jurisdiction name) and
   the full catalog `dispositions` tuple. A task type outside the catalog
   emits the honest literal `not yet classified` for class/effort/scope and
   the full §33.4 `Disposition` vocabulary — any outcome is legal for an
   unclassified type — never `contributor`, never `unknown`, never `[]`.
3. **The fixture intake surface is retired (QW-10; F-113/F-274).**
   `web/src/pages/task/new/[slug].astro`, `web/src/lib/task.ts`,
   `web/tests/unit/task.test.ts`, `TASKABLE_ABSENCES` and
   `dossierTaskableAbsences` are gone. `AbsenceHatch` renders a
   non-interactive named absence — the kind label plus
   `data-absence-kind/subject/predicate` — instead of an `<a>` into a
   fixture intake page. No "has been generated" text exists in tracked
   source; the built site emits no `task/` tree. `ops/public_routes.toml`
   demotes `task` to a plain `top_level` route (real `/task/<handle>/`
   pages stay publishable when RQ-03 lands) and adds `/task/new/` to
   `[[denied]]`, with matching `http-absent` probes on all three origins in
   `ops/cadence.toml`, so the retired prefix is probed absent on every
   sweep.
4. **Provenance labels name the page (C3 NEW-13).**
   `HowWeKnowThis.astro` accepts an optional `pageName`; `BaseLayout`
   forwards `provenanceName`. `/research-queue/` renders "These totals
   describe the research queue's own evidence, not the whole record." and
   `/corrections/` (the other page-scoped module) names itself the same
   way; site-scoped and unnamed page-scoped summaries keep their existing
   sentences.
5. **Copy batch + binding tests (B-2).** Rows appended `pending` to
   `docs/build/reports/copy-batches/batch-01.md`: `HW-10` (the page-named
   scope template), `RQ-01` (`not yet classified`, `lib/research-queue.ts`),
   `XC-03` (the same literal, `exports/spine_export.py`). `T-01`'s batch row
   stays (append-only) while its page is retired — the P34.11 binding test
   gains a `RETIRED_ROWS` set that requires exactly that: recorded, never
   carried.
6. **Static sweeps.** `tests/unit/test_p34_12_queue_truth.py` greps public
   source for the retired surface: no `/task/new/` links or routes, no
   "has been generated" text, no `AbsenceHatch` `<a>`, the retired seams
   absent from `fixtures.ts`/`dossier.ts`, the allow-list denial present,
   and the batch rows bound.

## Test plan

- `tests/exports/test_spine_export.py` — a catalog-typed queue row emits
  `task_id`, catalog `assignee_class`/`effort_estimate`/`geographic_scope`
  and dispositions ⊆ `Disposition`; an unclassified type emits
  `not yet classified` + the full vocabulary; a duplicated
  `(task_type, subject_id)` still dedupes on `task_id`.
- `web/tests/unit/research-queue.test.ts` — `taskAnchor` shape + fallback,
  `assertUniqueTaskAnchors` throws on collision, `jurisdictionAnchors`
  targets rendered cards only, `NOT_YET_CLASSIFIED` is rendered.
- `web/tests/e2e` — every `jurisdiction-filter` href resolves to an
  existing card `id`; all card ids distinct; `hwkt-scope` names the
  research queue; the absence hatch is named text, never a link;
  `/task/new/<anything>/` 404s; no page links `/task/new/`.
- `tests/unit/test_p34_12_queue_truth.py` — the public-source sweep above.
- `tests/unit/test_p34_11_copy_batch.py` — extended with `RETIRED_ROWS`;
  all batch hashes still verify.
- `tests/ops/test_scheduled.py` — the denied-route ↔ http-absent-probe
  correspondence now covers `/task/new/` on all three origins.

## Boundaries / notes

- **No production mutation, no republish.** `live_verification=false`; the
  public effect rides P34.17's republish #1. The cadence edits are probe
  *config* — nothing was deployed or probed.
- **Export-shaping only.** The catalog join changes what the export writes
  for `research_queue` rows; no detector run, no `research_task` writes,
  no spine reads beyond the existing query. `D-R7.2-DETECTORS` (the real
  hosted detector run) stays OPEN and gated — no hosted queue count is
  asserted anywhere.
- **`task_id` is optional in the frozen contract** so pre-P34.12 exports
  keep validating; the web card falls back to a `(task_type, subject_id)`
  anchor when it is absent.
- **Copy status.** The three new rows are `pending` — under B-2 only
  `confirmed` copy ships, so republish #1 stays gated on the operator's
  verbatim confirmation.
